pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: simple gable 48 by 39 ft, ridge along the NE-SW axis through about (461,583) to (656,444), about 4/12; both ends gable ends

pieces.name: porch
pieces.notes: small entry gable at the SW end of the SE eave, centred near (551,641), ridge perpendicular to the main, about 3.6/12, faces SW and NE per LiDAR (68 and 66 sq ft); it sticks about 5 ft past the main eave and matches the step in the trace

exclude_notes: tree crown overhanging the NW eave near the N corner
notes: One gable plus a small cross gable porch (v1 had it as a shed strip along the whole SW half of the eave). Confidence high.
